meta.description: ANNA CYCLE helps small farmers, vendors, buyers and storage operators find a clear next step for surplus produce before it is lost.

landing.heroTitle: Every batch of produce deserves a next step.
landing.heroBody: ANNA CYCLE helps small farmers, vendors, buyers and storage operators coordinate surplus produce before it is lost: nearby buyers, split-batch sales, short-term storage and safe recovery pathways.

sample.label: Sample batch
sample.note: Reserved plus available quantity can never exceed the batch total.

steps.title: List surplus
steps.body: Record the produce, quantity, condition, location and a recovery deadline in one short form.

steps.title: Match and split
steps.body: Nearby buyers reserve parts of a batch. The system keeps count of what is reserved and what is still available.

steps.title: Recover
steps.body: If a sale stalls, the Recovery Engine suggests other buyers, storage or other pathways, and explains why.

landing.pathwaysBody: Rule-based, transparent recommendations. Food safety checks always come before financial recovery.

pathways.title: Match another buyer
pathways.body: Find buyers whose needs fit the batch.

pathways.title: Split the batch
pathways.body: Sell smaller quantities to several buyers.

pathways.title: Use short-term storage
pathways.body: Book a compatible hub for a limited time.

pathways.title: Approved recovery partner
pathways.body: Refer eligible produce to a verified partner (demonstration only).

landing.hubsBody: Find short-duration storage matched to the crop. Not every vegetable should be refrigerated.

hubTypes.name: Community Micro-Hub
hubTypes.body: Existing suitable spaces adapted for short-duration storage.

hubTypes.name: ANNA Modular Hub
hubTypes.body: A proposed modular design with configurable ventilation and cooling where appropriate.

hubTypes.name: Partner Storage Hub
hubTypes.body: Existing storage facilities run by third parties.

landing.hubNote: Bookings run 1 to 3 days at most. That is a maximum, not a guarantee that produce stays usable.
honestItems: Recommendations are rule-based. There is no AI model behind them.
No shelf-life predictions. We record reported condition, times and handling.
Food safety checks come before financial recovery.
Demonstration hubs and listings are labelled sample data until verified.
Estimated and verified outcomes are always shown separately.
landing.footer: ANNA CYCLE is a student-built prototype for the Global Sustainability Challenge. All data shown is sample data.

impact.title: Impact
impact.intro: How far produce got at each step. Every figure says what it is based on. Listed produce is not counted as saved food.
impact.banner: All figures below come from sample data, so none of them is a real result.

listed: Total put up for sale. This is not saved food.
matched: Kilograms a buyer has asked for or reserved.
sold: Kilograms where the seller confirmed the buyer.
redirected: Kilograms sent to storage or another pathway.
verified_recovered: Collected kilograms backed by a record. Needs confirmation in live use.
estimated_value: Collected kilograms times the ASKING price. Not what was actually paid.

impact.bannerLocal: Figures count only records created on this site. Sample data is left out. “Collected” is what sellers reported, so check it before relying on it.
